resume_brief: Owner 2026-10-10: Magnolia Rune (the rough v1 font from the Magnolia Square sign) needs a full character set — lowercase a-z, digits 0-9, punctuation. Current TTF at ~/workspace/font-wizard/fonts/magnolia-square/MagnoliaRune-Regular.ttf has only 11 uppercase glyphs (A,G,I,L,M,N,O,Q,R,S,U) traced from the sign. Design the missing glyphs IN THE SAME ROUGH/RUNIC STYLE as the existing tracings — jagged blackletter, matching weight and character. Missing: B,C,D,E,F,H,J,K,P,T,V,W,X,Y,Z uppercase; full lowercase a-z; 0-9; punctuation (. , ! ? ' - : ;). Match the style, don't clean it up — the roughness IS the style. Update the TTF, re-render specimen. Branch → PR → merge on font-wizard.
